signIn.title: Welcome
signIn.subtitle: This app is offline and local-only — signing in here doesn't create a real account or send anything anywhere. It's just how the app greets you.
signIn.emailHint: Never sent anywhere — stored only on this device, in case you want it later.

profile.title: A few things about you
profile.subtitle: All optional except where noted. This stays on your device, and you can change any of it later in Settings → Profile.
profile.sexHint: Used only to estimate blood alcohol level. Skip it and that estimate is simply turned off — everything else keeps working.
profile.ageUnderNotice: This app assumes a legal drinking age. You can keep using it either way — nothing is blocked.
profile.weightHint: Used only for the blood alcohol estimate.
profile.heightHint: Stats only — never used for the alcohol estimate.
profile.spendLabel: What did you spend on alcohol before tracking?
profile.spendHint: A rough figure is fine. This is the baseline the Savings dashboard compares against — skip it and that dashboard just stays off until you add one.
profile.reasonsHint: Pick as many as apply. This only changes what's shown first — everything stays reachable either way.
profile.contextSubtitle: This only changes what's emphasized first — everything stays reachable from the menu either way.
profile.doneSubtitle: Everything above is editable any time in Settings → Profile.

today.longestRun: Your longest run so far: {{count}} days
today.nothingLoggedToday: Nothing logged today. That's just information, not a verdict.

savingsHero.pareto: About 20% effort can bring 80% of the benefit — financial, and for a health that has no price tag.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Whatever you log stays on this device. Start whenever you like.
history.noMatchBody: Try a wider date range or a different category.

insights.title: Insights
insights.emptyTodayBody: Once you log something, today's breakdown shows up here.
insights.emptyBody: Once you log a few drinks, this is where the patterns show up — units, spending, categories, and alcohol-free days.
insights.addPricesHint: Add prices when you log to see this fill in
insights.goalShareLabel: daily share of your weekly goal

settingsHome.footerNote: Tally keeps everything locally. No account, no server, no analytics — nothing leaves this device unless you export it yourself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataRowSubtitle: {{count}} entries, stored on this device only
settings.footerDisclaimer: Tally keeps everything locally. No account, no server, no analytics — nothing leaves this device unless you export it yourself.
settings.accountRowSubtitle: Optional — keep your history safe across devices

savings.title: Savings
savings.noBaselinePrompt: Add what you used to spend on alcohol and this dashboard will compare it to what you're logging now.
savings.disclaimerNeutral: Whichever way this goes, it's just what the numbers show — not a verdict.

help.title: Help & resources
help.disclaimer: This app is not a medical device and does not replace professional diagnosis or care. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.
help.seekHelpTitle: When it might help to talk to someone
help.seekHelpIntro: None of this is a diagnosis — just signals worth taking seriously enough to ask a professional.
help.noResourcesForCountry: No specific contacts loaded for this country yet — here is general information instead.
help.verifyContacts: Contact details can change. If something here doesn't work, search the service's name directly.

tickets.reportTitle: Report a problem / suggest an improvement
tickets.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened, or what you'd like to see
tickets.myTicketsIntro: Stored on this device only — nothing here is sent anywhere automatically yet. Export to CSV from Settings → Data & privacy to review on a computer.
tickets.autoCaptured: App version and platform are attached automatically.

bac.title: Rough estimate
bac.disclaimer: A textbook calculation, not a measurement — never rely on this to decide whether to drive.
bac.soberNote: Back to zero, going by this estimate.

encouragement.subtitleZero: Every day logged is useful data. No judgement here.
encouragement.milestone14: Two weeks. That is a real stretch.
encouragement.freeDaysReached: {{count}} alcohol-free days this week — goal reached.
encouragement.freeDaysProgress: {{count}} of {{goal}} alcohol-free days so far. {{remaining}} to go.
encouragement.emptyState1: Nothing logged yet. Add a drink whenever you like.
encouragement.emptyState2: Your log is private and stays on this device.
encouragement.emptyState3: Start whenever. There is no streak to break here.

unitsScreen.volumeCaption: How serving sizes are entered and shown.
unitsScreen.intakeCaption: Standard drinks are easier to compare; grams of pure alcohol are exact.
unitsScreen.oneServingCaption: Countries define this differently. Pick the one you think in.
unitsScreen.weightCaption: Used for the profile's blood alcohol estimate.

goalsScreen.optionalBody: Goals are yours to set, change, or ignore. Nothing here locks, warns, or nags — a goal just draws a quiet line on your charts so you can see where you are relative to it.
goalsScreen.weeklyIntakeHint: Leave empty for no weekly target.
goalsScreen.freeDaysHint: Between 0 and 7. Leave empty to skip.

historyScreen.title: History
historyScreen.noMatchBody: Try a wider date range or a different category.
historyScreen.emptyBody: Whatever you log stays on this device. Start whenever you like.

drinksScreen.intro: Presets you created. They appear at the top of the picker when you log a drink.
drinksScreen.emptyBody: Add your own preset for anything the catalog does not cover — a homemade panaché, a specific bottle, your usual pour.

drinkEdit.priceHint: Pre-filled when you log this drink.
drinkEdit.deletedToast: Preset deleted. Past entries are untouched.
drinkEdit.deleteConfirmBody: The preset is removed. Entries you already logged with it stay in your history.

logScreen.createCustomSubtitle: Your own preset, with its own ABV and price
logScreen.noMatchBody: Nothing in the catalog fits “{{query}}”. You can add it as a custom drink.
logScreen.rowA11yHint: Opens details. Long press to log straight away with the defaults.

logDetails.unavailable: That drink is no longer available.

entryScreen.deleteHint: Deleting removes it from your charts too.
entryScreen.deleteConfirmBody: It will be removed from your history.

entryForm.volumeHint: Enter a volume greater than zero.

dataScreen.whereBody: Everything is stored in a local database on this device by default. There is no account, no sync and no analytics unless you turn on optional cloud sync from Account & cloud sync in Settings — nothing leaves this device otherwise.
dataScreen.exportBody: CSV opens in any spreadsheet. JSON keeps everything, including your custom drinks and settings.
dataScreen.exportTicketsBody: Bug reports and suggestions you logged from Settings → Report a problem. Nothing is sent anywhere automatically in this version — export is how you get them off the device.
dataScreen.deleteBody: Removes every entry, custom drink, your profile, tickets and settings from this device, and brings back onboarding. The built-in drink catalog is restored so the app still works afterwards.
dataScreen.sharingUnavailableToast: Sharing is not available on this device
dataScreen.deleteConfirmBody: Your entries, custom drinks and settings will be removed from this device. This cannot be undone.

appearanceScreen.previewBody: This is how the streak card will look.

pricesScreen.intro: A default price is filled in automatically when you log that drink. You can always change it for a single entry.

subscriptionScreen.intro: The free version stays free — drink logging, statistics, everything else. Premium would remove the launch message and the small support banner below, and help fund the app.
subscriptionScreen.freeTierBody: Everything works on the free tier. Free users also see a short, skippable message when the app opens — about support & addiction resources, never a real ad — and a small banner right here.
subscriptionScreen.previewNotice: Offer preview. Payments aren't open yet: nothing is charged, and no payment details are ever requested.

adminScreen.banner: This is a local preview of what a future admin panel could show — the user side (this device's own data) and the admin side (tickets, subscription state, catalog overrides). Subscription state is now backed by the real backend in server/; everything else here is still this device's own local data.
adminScreen.catalogOverridesBody: {{count}} catalog drinks have a translated display name in the current language; the rest keep their original international name (Absinthe, Baijiu, Prosecco, ...) since that's already correct in most languages.

psa.title: Before you dive in
psa.message1: Struggling with any kind of habit that feels bigger than you? You're not alone, and real help exists — see Help & Resources.
psa.message2: Whatever brought you here, tracking is already a form of care for yourself.
psa.message3: Addiction isn't only about alcohol — gambling, screens, work, anything can take hold. Free, confidential help is a tap away.
psa.message4: You don't have to have it all figured out. One honest entry today is enough.
psa.message5: If a habit ever feels out of your control — any habit — real people are ready to help.

shop.title: Go Premium
shop.body: Removes the launch message and the small support banner — {{price}}.

account.notConfiguredTitle: Cloud sync isn't set up on this build
account.notConfiguredBody: This app works fully offline without an account. Cloud sync needs a Firebase project to be configured first — see the README's "Accounts & cloud sync" section.
account.localOnlyIntro: Everything already works with no account at all — this is entirely optional. Creating an account keeps your history safe if this device is lost, and lets you pick up the same log on another device.
account.whatIsStoredTitle: What gets stored in the cloud
account.whatIsStoredBody: Your drink log, custom drinks, and profile — the same fields already on this device, nothing more. See the Privacy Policy for details.
account.resetSentToast: Password reset email sent — check your inbox.
account.resetFailedToast: Couldn't send the reset email. Check the address and try again.
account.signOutConfirmBody: Your data stays on this device and in the cloud. You can sign back in anytime.
account.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account and everything stored for it in the cloud. Data already on this device is not affected — use "Delete all data" for that.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and all of its cloud data. This can't be undone.
account.errorInvalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
account.errorEmailInUse: There's already an account with that email — try signing in instead.
account.errorWeakPassword: Choose a password with at least 6 characters.
account.errorUserNotFound: No account found with that email.
account.errorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts — wait a moment and try again.
account.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
account.appleNotice: Apple sign-in isn't set up on this build yet — email and Google sign-in both work today.

authGate.title: Welcome to Tally
authGate.subtitle: Create an account or sign in to get started — your history stays backed up and available on every device.
authGate.dataNotice: We store your drink log, custom drinks and profile — the same fields you'll see in the app, nothing more. See the Privacy Policy for details.
